title: 万兽纪元原创觉醒式地图界面资产
ownership: OpenAI ImageGen original for Beastbound Odyssey

authorization.usageScope: Beastbound Odyssey project runtime and derivative production under applicable OpenAI terms

referencePolicy.use: world-map hierarchy, density and interaction intent only
referencePolicy.statement: 外部地图截图只用于理解成熟的当前地图、区域地图与世界地图层级；本包未复制、裁切、描摹或嵌入参考游戏的岛屿轮廓、地名、标志、角色或像素。

generation.method: OpenAI built-in ImageGen original raster generation
generation.derivation: direct lossless generated PNG; Godot applies aspect-preserving display only

replacementPolicy.rule: 使用同一用途合同重新生成版本化世界图底板，保留区域热区 ID 与运行时路径映射；复核尺寸、SHA-256、九区可辨识度和 1280x720 实机截图后再替换。
replacementPolicy.ownerAcceptance: 项目所有者明确接受冻结实机截图前保持 owner_review_pending。

assets.responsibility: 世界地图九个真实区域的原创无字底板
